description: Proposes next week's strength sessions from the stored plan (set_plan), what the journal says the user ACTUALLY lifted (log_session) and how recovered they are. Writes and pushes NOTHING: show the proposal to the user; to queue it pass `queuePayload` to queue_adjustment (nothing reaches the watch until resolve_approval). predict: true also returns a log_prediction payload per increase (never logged here). Repeats the latest guided plan week one week on (weekStart: a Monday after today, default next Monday). Loads follow NAMED rules in `rulesUsed` (`rules` overrides some within stated ranges; unknown names refused): PROGRESS when the lift's latest logged session hit every planned rep at one weight (+ one step: at most incrementKg 2.5 kg, 5% of the load, at least 1.25 kg); HOLD on other evidence; DELOAD (deloadPct 10%) after stallSessions (2) logged misses in a row, or when today's TSB is below tsbDeloadBelow (-25), or when HRV and waking recovery are both below the user's band. NEVER raises a load without evidence: no log_session entry for the plan's sets x reps, HRV or recovery below the band, or an unread history means no increase; a lift whose detail has no kg or 'NxM' is untouched. status 'insufficient' (`missing` says why) with no plan, no guided session, under 2 logged sessions in 8 weeks or no usable lift. Result: sessions (for set_plan merge), guides (for push_week_plan), changes with reasons, forecast, risk (heuristic: forecast TSB below -30, or week TSS over 30% above the 4-week average), queuePayload. MODEL-BASED: projections and rule outputs, not predictions of how the user will respond.

predict.description: true: also return a log_prediction payload per proposed increase (never logged here). Default false.

rules.description: Optional overrides of the named rules (unknown names are refused), each a number inside its stated range.

deloadPct.description: A deload lowers the load by this percent, rounded to 1.25 kg.

incrementKg.description: Largest load step of a progression, in kg (never more than 5% of the load, never less than 1.25 kg).

stallSessions.description: Logged sessions of one lift in a row that did not hit every planned set and rep at one weight; reaching this many deloads the lift.

tsbDeloadBelow.description: Every load with a kg figure is deloaded when today's TSB (Form) is below this.

tsbRiskFloor.description: The forecast flags the week when its lowest TSB is below this (-30 is the 'high risk' zone of the usual Form scale).

weeklyJumpPct.description: The forecast flags the week when its TSS is more than this percent above the average week of the 28 days before it (acute:chronic about 1.3).

weekStart.description: The Monday the week starts on, YYYY-MM-DD; after today. Default: next Monday.

name: propose_next_week
title: Propose next week's strength sessions (read-only: returns a proposal and a queuePayload, writes nothing)
